name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app (`npx create-next-app` completed), installed CopilotKit packages (`npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/runtime` added 1166 packages), and created all required files: the API route at `app/api/copilotkit/[[...slug]]/route.ts`, the provider-wrapped `app/layout.tsx`, and the `app/page.tsx` with `CopilotSidebar`. TypeScript validation (`npx tsc --noEmit`) passed cleanly with exit code 0. However, `npm run build` timed out after 120 seconds while still in the "Creating an optimized production build" phase, so I could not demonstrably verify that the app builds and serves with a working copilot endpoint. The docs site `docs.copilotkit.ai` was unreachable due to TLS connection resets, so I had to fetch the quickstart content from the CopilotKit GitHub repository instead.

installed.evidence: npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/runtime returned added 1166 packages, and audited 1532 packages in 1m

configured.evidence: npx tsc --noEmit returned exit=0 after the route, layout, page and .env files were written

first_call.evidence: timeout 120 npm run build returned exit=124 and output stopped at Creating an optimized production build ...

verified.evidence: npm run build timed out after 120 seconds while still in Creating an optimized production build, so the app never built or served

friction.where: GitHub raw quickstart path not obvious
